objective: Simulate final evidence bundles after model semantic assessment and deterministic admission policy for the frozen 16-case rich gold.
finding: All scored models retained 100% required-evidence recall. Gemini produced 0% semantic-noise admission and the smallest average bundle among the three model treatments, while Sonnet/Opus preserved more conflict evidence but admitted more gold-rejected evidence.
decision: Stop model-label bakeoff as the primary seam. Proceed to downstream answer evaluation on the resulting bundles; keep Oracle as a ceiling and Native as the missing baseline arm.
next_step: Execute bundle → answer evaluation with identical frozen questions and blind evaluation.
